# Architecture Recommendation

I recommend a **microservices architecture deployed on a managed cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP)** using containerization (Docker/Kubernetes) with serverless components for variable workloads. This approach balances maintainability through service isolation and independent deployment, while optimizing costs through auto-scaling, pay-per-use serverless services, and efficient resource utilization. Use Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform/CloudFormation) to further enhance maintainability and reduce operational overhead.
